intent: move one admitted Issue through isolated execution, exact-head provider landing, and local machine reconciliation

entry_points.description: an exact Issue satisfies the Noodles scheduling contract

states.description: the Issue is ready for scheduling
Noodle owns one isolated execution worktree
execution handed an exact PR head to the provider lane
GitHub readback proves the exact subject landed
local main and Noodle machine state are reconciled
an unavailable provider prevents landing readback

transitions.action: validate the PR and emit the blocking handoff
read back exact-head merge and Issue closure
fast-forward local main and acknowledge Noodle control

observables.assertion: provider receipt, default-branch ancestry, control acknowledgement, and backlog completion name the same subject

persistence.boundary: new process reads landed Issue and reconciled local state
